pages.text: The $(bold)Frying Pan$() can only be placed on top of a $(bold)Variable Temperature Oven$().$(br)First right-click with $(bold)cooking oil$() to add oil (up to 64), then right-click with fryable ingredients - the oil count must be at least as many as the ingredients.$(br2)When ready, $(bold)right-click$() with an empty hand to start frying.

When frying is done, $(bold)right-click$() with an empty hand to collect the results into your inventory.$(br)$(bold)Shift-right-click$() to take out ingredients or oil.$(br2)It cannot be interacted with while working; keep an eye on the oil and refill it when you're told it's running low.
